Because of the restriction on this class, all members of IceCream must use the hasTopping property, and therefore must also be members of Pizza. The parent class is used in restrictions, and the covering axiom means that only members of the subclasses may be used as values.     <!-- http://www.co-ode.org/ontologies/pizza/pizza.owl#VegetarianPizza -->

    <owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.co-ode.org/ontologies/pizza/pizza.owl#VegetarianPizza">
        <owl:equivalentClass>
            <owl:Class>
                <owl:intersectionOf rdf:parseType="Collection">
                    <rdf:Description rdf:about="http://www.co-ode.org/ontologies/pizza/pizza.owl#Pizza"/>
                    <owl:Class>
                        <owl:complementOf>
                            <owl:Restriction>
                                <owl:onProperty rdf:resource="http://www.co-ode.org/ontologies/pizza/pizza.owl#hasTopping"/>
                                <owl:someValuesFrom rdf:resource="http://www.co-ode.org/ontologies/pizza/pizza.owl#FishTopping"/>
                            </owl:Restriction>
                        </owl:complementOf>
                    </owl:Class>
                    <owl:Class>
                        <owl:complementOf>
                            <owl:Restriction>
                                <owl:onProperty rdf:resource="http://www.co-ode.org/ontologies/pizza/pizza.owl#hasTopping"/>
                                <owl:someValuesFrom rdf:resource="http://www.co-ode.org/ontologies/pizza/pizza.owl#MeatTopping"/>
                            </owl:Restriction>
                        </owl:complementOf>
                    </owl:Class>
                </owl:intersectionOf>
            </owl:Class>
        </owl:equivalentClass>

                        <owl:allValuesFrom rdf:resource="http://www.co-ode.org/ontologies/pizza/pizza.owl#VegetarianTopping"/>
                    </owl:Restriction>
                </owl:intersectionOf>
            </owl:Class>
        </owl:equivalentClass>
        <rdfs:comment xml:lang="en">Any pizza that only has vegetarian toppings or no toppings is a VegetarianPizzaEquiv1. Should be inferred to be equivalent to VegetarianPizzaEquiv2.  Not equivalent to VegetarianPizza because PizzaTopping is not covering</rdfs:comment>

        <rdfs:label xml:lang="en">VegetarianPizza1</rdfs:label>
        <skos:prefLabel xml:lang="en">Vegetarian Pizza1</skos:prefLabel>
    </owl:Class>

            <owl:Class>
                <owl:intersectionOf rdf:parseType="Collection">
                    <rdf:Description rdf:about="http://www.co-ode.org/ontologies/pizza/pizza.owl#Pizza"/>
                    <owl:Restriction>
                        <owl:onProperty rdf:resource="http://www.co-ode.org/ontologies/pizza/pizza.owl#hasTopping"/>

                                    <rdf:Description rdf:about="http://www.co-ode.org/ontologies/pizza/pizza.owl#VegetableTopping"/>
                                </owl:unionOf>
                            </owl:Class>
                        </owl:allValuesFrom>
                    </owl:Restriction>
                </owl:intersectionOf>
            </owl:Class>
        </owl:equivalentClass>

The parent class is used in restrictions, and the covering axiom means that only members of the subclasses may be used as values.     <owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.co-ode.org/ontologies/pizza/pizza.owl#VegetarianPizza">
        <owl:equivalentClass>
            <owl:Class>
                <owl:intersectionOf rdf:parseType="Collection">
                    <rdf:Description rdf:about="http://www.co-ode.org/ontologies/pizza/pizza.owl#Pizza"/>
                    <owl:Class>
                        <owl:complementOf>
                            <owl:Restriction>
                                <owl:onProperty rdf:resource="http://www.co-ode.org/ontologies/pizza/pizza.owl#hasTopping"/>
                                <owl:someValuesFrom rdf:resource="http://www.co-ode.org/ontologies/pizza/pizza.owl#FishTopping"/>
                            </owl:Restriction>
                        </owl:complementOf>
                    </owl:Class>
                    <owl:Class>
                        <owl:complementOf>
                            <owl:Restriction>
                                <owl:onProperty rdf:resource="http://www.co-ode.org/ontologies/pizza/pizza.owl#hasTopping"/>
                                <owl:someValuesFrom rdf:resource="http://www.co-ode.org/ontologies/pizza/pizza.owl#MeatTopping"/>
                            </owl:Restriction>
                        </owl:complementOf>
                    </owl:Class>
                </owl:intersectionOf>
            </owl:Class>
        </owl:equivalentClass>

        <rdfs:label xml:lang="en">VegetarianPizza</rdfs:label>

    </owl:Class>

                        <owl:allValuesFrom rdf:resource="http://www.co-ode.org/ontologies/pizza/pizza.owl#VegetarianTopping"/>
                    </owl:Restriction>
                </owl:intersectionOf>
            </owl:Class>
        </owl:equivalentClass>
        <rdfs:comment xml:lang="en">Any pizza that only has vegetarian toppings or no toppings is a VegetarianPizzaEquiv1. Should be inferred to be equivalent to VegetarianPizzaEquiv2.  Not equivalent to VegetarianPizza because PizzaTopping is not covering</rdfs:comment>

        <rdfs:label xml:lang="en">VegetarianPizza1</rdfs:label>
        <skos:prefLabel xml:lang="en">Vegetarian Pizza1</skos:prefLabel>
    </owl:Class>

                <owl:intersectionOf rdf:parseType="Collection">

                                    <rdf:Description rdf:about="http://www.co-ode.org/ontologies/pizza/pizza.owl#VegetableTopping"/>
                                </owl:unionOf>
                            </owl:Class>
                        </owl:allValuesFrom>
                    </owl:Restriction>
                </owl:intersectionOf>
            </owl:Class>
        </owl:equivalentClass>

The parent class is used in restrictions, and the covering axiom means that only members of the subclasses may be used as values.                             </owl:Restriction>
                        </owl:complementOf>
                    </owl:Class>

                        <owl:complementOf>

                                </owl:unionOf>
                            </owl:Class>
                        </owl:allValuesFrom>
                    </owl:Restriction>
                </owl:intersectionOf>
            </owl:Class>

    <owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.co-ode.org/ontologies/pizza/pizza.owl#VegetarianPizza">
        <owl:equivalentClass>
            <owl:Class>
                <owl:intersectionOf rdf:parseType="Collection">
                    <rdf:Description rdf:about="http://www.co-ode.org/ontologies/pizza/pizza.owl#Pizza"/>
                    <owl:Class>
                        <owl:complementOf>
                            <owl:Restriction>
                                <owl:onProperty rdf:resource="http://www.co-ode.org/ontologies/pizza/pizza.owl#hasTopping"/>
                                <owl:someValuesFrom rdf:resource="http://www.co-ode.org/ontologies/pizza/pizza.owl#FishTopping"/>
                            </owl:Restriction>
                        </owl:complementOf>
                    </owl:Class>
                    <owl:Class>
                        <owl:complementOf>
                            <owl:Restriction>
                                <owl:onProperty rdf:resource="http://www.co-ode.org/ontologies/pizza/pizza.owl#hasTopping"/>
                                <owl:someValuesFrom rdf:resource="http://www.co-ode.org/ontologies/pizza/pizza.owl#MeatTopping"/>
                            </owl:Restriction>
                        </owl:complementOf>
                    </owl:Class>
                </owl:intersectionOf>
            </owl:Class>
        </owl:equivalentClass>

        <rdfs:label xml:lang="en">VegetarianPizza</rdfs:label>

    <!-- http://www.co-ode.org/ontologies/pizza/pizza.owl#VegetarianPizzaEquivalent1 -->

                    <owl:Restriction>
                        <owl:onProperty rdf:resource="http://www.co-ode.org/ontologies/pizza/pizza.owl#hasTopping"/>

                    </owl:Restriction>

        </owl:equivalentClass>
        <rdfs:comment xml:lang="en">Any pizza that only has vegetarian toppings or no toppings is a VegetarianPizzaEquiv1. Should be inferred to be equivalent to VegetarianPizzaEquiv2.  Not equivalent to VegetarianPizza because PizzaTopping is not covering</rdfs:comment>

    <owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.co-ode.org/ontologies/pizza/pizza.owl#VegetarianPizza">
        <owl:equivalentClass>
            <owl:Class>
                <owl:intersectionOf rdf:parseType="Collection">
                    <rdf:Description rdf:about="http://www.co-ode.org/ontologies/pizza/pizza.owl#Pizza"/>
                    <owl:Class>
                        <owl:complementOf>
                            <owl:Restriction>
                                <owl:onProperty rdf:resource="http://www.co-ode.org/ontologies/pizza/pizza.owl#hasTopping"/>
                                <owl:someValuesFrom rdf:resource="http://www.co-ode.org/ontologies/pizza/pizza.owl#FishTopping"/>
                            </owl:Restriction>
                        </owl:complementOf>
                    </owl:Class>
                    <owl:Class>
                        <owl:complementOf>
                            <owl:Restriction>
                                <owl:onProperty rdf:resource="http://www.co-ode.org/ontologies/pizza/pizza.owl#hasTopping"/>
                                <owl:someValuesFrom rdf:resource="http://www.co-ode.org/ontologies/pizza/pizza.owl#MeatTopping"/>
                            </owl:Restriction>
                        </owl:complementOf>
                    </owl:Class>
                </owl:intersectionOf>
            </owl:Class>
        </owl:equivalentClass>

    </owl:Class>

                        <owl:allValuesFrom rdf:resource="http://www.co-ode.org/ontologies/pizza/pizza.owl#VegetarianTopping"/>
                    </owl:Restriction>
                </owl:intersectionOf>
            </owl:Class>
        </owl:equivalentClass>
        <rdfs:comment xml:lang="en">Any pizza that only has vegetarian toppings or no toppings is a VegetarianPizzaEquiv1. Should be inferred to be equivalent to VegetarianPizzaEquiv2.  Not equivalent to VegetarianPizza because PizzaTopping is not covering</rdfs:comment>
        <rdfs:label xml:lang="pt">PizzaVegetarianaEquivalente1</rdfs:label>
        <rdfs:label xml:lang="en">VegetarianPizza1</rdfs:label>
        <skos:prefLabel xml:lang="en">Vegetarian Pizza1</skos:prefLabel>
    </owl:Class>

            <owl:Class>
                <owl:intersectionOf rdf:parseType="Collection">
                    <rdf:Description rdf:about="http://www.co-ode.org/ontologies/pizza/pizza.owl#Pizza"/>
                    <owl:Restriction>
                        <owl:onProperty rdf:resource="http://www.co-ode.org/ontologies/pizza/pizza.owl#hasTopping"/>

                                    <rdf:Description rdf:about="http://www.co-ode.org/ontologies/pizza/pizza.owl#VegetableTopping"/>
                                </owl:unionOf>
                            </owl:Class>
                        </owl:allValuesFrom>
                    </owl:Restriction>
                </owl:intersectionOf>
            </owl:Class>
        </owl:equivalentClass>

This means that the reasoner can infer that all individuals using the hasTopping property must be of type Pizza. Because of the restriction on this class, all members of IceCream must use the hasTopping property, and therefore must also be members of Pizza. However, Pizza and IceCream are disjoint, so this causes an inconsistency. If they were not disjoint, IceCream would be inferred to be a subclass of Pizza.</rdfs:comment>

A QCR would specify from which class the members in this relationship must be. eg has at least 3 toppings from PizzaTopping. This is currently not supported in OWL.</skos:definition>

        <owl:equivalentClass>
            <owl:Class>
                <owl:intersectionOf rdf:parseType="Collection">
                    <rdf:Description rdf:about="http://www.co-ode.org/ontologies/pizza/pizza.owl#Pizza"/>
                    <owl:Class>
                        <owl:complementOf>
                            <owl:Restriction>
                                <owl:onProperty rdf:resource="http://www.co-ode.org/ontologies/pizza/pizza.owl#hasTopping"/>
                                <owl:someValuesFrom rdf:resource="http://www.co-ode.org/ontologies/pizza/pizza.owl#FishTopping"/>
                            </owl:Restriction>
                        </owl:complementOf>
                    </owl:Class>
                    <owl:Class>
                        <owl:complementOf>
                            <owl:Restriction>
                                <owl:onProperty rdf:resource="http://www.co-ode.org/ontologies/pizza/pizza.owl#hasTopping"/>
                                <owl:someValuesFrom rdf:resource="http://www.co-ode.org/ontologies/pizza/pizza.owl#MeatTopping"/>

                        </owl:complementOf>
                    </owl:Class>
                </owl:intersectionOf>
            </owl:Class>
        </owl:equivalentClass>

        </owl:equivalentClass>

        <rdfs:label xml:lang="en">VegetarianPizza1</rdfs:label>

                                </owl:unionOf>
                            </owl:Class>
                        </owl:allValuesFrom>
                    </owl:Restriction>
                </owl:intersectionOf>
            </owl:Class>

responses.answer:
**Answer**

All toppings are disjoint with `MeatTopping`, so the query returns every topping class in the ontology.

**Inference steps**

1. The ontology declares a disjointness axiom for each topping class with `MeatTopping` (e.g., `ChickenTopping owl:disjointWith MeatTopping`).
2. The SPARQL query selects any `?topping` that is `owl:disjointWith` some `?meat` that is a subclass of `MeatTopping`.
3. Because every topping class is explicitly disjoint with `MeatTopping`, each satisfies the query’s pattern.
4. Therefore the result set contains all topping classes defined in the ontology.

The parent class is used in restrictions, and the covering axiom means that only members of the subclasses may be used as values. The possible subclasses cannot be extended without updating the ValuePartition class.</rdfs:comment>

                            </owl:Restriction>
                        </owl:complementOf>
                    </owl:Class>
                    <owl:Class>
                        <owl:complementOf>
                            <owl:Restriction>

                    </owl:Class>

                                    <rdf:Description rdf:about="http://www.co-ode.org/ontologies/pizza/pizza.owl#SauceTopping"/>
                                    <rdf:Description rdf:about="http://www.co-ode.org/ontologies/pizza/pizza.owl#VegetableTopping"/>
                                </owl:unionOf>
                            </owl:Class>
                        </owl:allValuesFrom>
                    </owl:Restriction>
                </owl:intersectionOf>
            </owl:Class>
        </owl:equivalentClass>

                    <rdf:Description rdf:about="http://www.co-ode.org/ontologies/pizza/pizza.owl#PizzaTopping"/>
                    <owl:Class>
                        <owl:unionOf rdf:parseType="Collection">
                            <rdf:Description rdf:about="http://www.co-ode.org/ontologies/pizza/pizza.owl#CheeseTopping"/>
                            <rdf:Description rdf:about="http://www.co-ode.org/ontologies/pizza/pizza.owl#FruitTopping"/>

            </owl:Class>
        </owl:equivalentClass>

            <owl:Class>
                <owl:intersectionOf rdf:parseType="Collection">
                    <rdf:Description rdf:about="http://www.co-ode.org/ontologies/pizza/pizza.owl#Pizza"/>

                        <owl:complementOf>

                                <owl:onProperty rdf:resource="http://www.co-ode.org/ontologies/pizza/pizza.owl#hasTopping"/>

                            </owl:Restriction>
                        </owl:complementOf>
                    </owl:Class>

                        <owl:complementOf>

responses.answer:
**Pizzas with no meat toppings**

- FruttiDiMare  
- Giardiniera  
- Margherita  
- Mushroom  
- Napoletana  
- QuattroFormaggi  
- Veneziana  

**Inference steps**

1. Each pizza class is defined as an intersection of `Pizza` and a restriction on `hasTopping`.  
2. The restriction is of the form `owl:allValuesFrom` with a union of topping categories.  
3. A pizza qualifies for “no meat toppings” if its union **does not contain** the class `MeatTopping`.  
4. Inspecting the ontology, the following pizzas have all‑values‑from unions that exclude `MeatTopping`:  
   - `FruttiDiMare` (FishTopping, CheeseTopping, VegetableTopping, SauceTopping)  
   - `Giardiniera` (VegetableTopping, CheeseTopping, SauceTopping)  
   - `Margherita` (CheeseTopping, VegetableTopping, SauceTopping)

   - `Veneziana` (TomatoTopping, CaperTopping, MozzarellaTopping, OliveTopping, OnionTopping, PineKernels, SultanaTopping)  
5. All other pizza classes include `MeatTopping` in their all‑values‑from union, so they are excluded.

    <owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.co-ode.org/ontologies/pizza/pizza.owl#VegetarianPizza">
        <owl:equivalentClass>
            <owl:Class>
                <owl:intersectionOf rdf:parseType="Collection">
                    <rdf:Description rdf:about="http://www.co-ode.org/ontologies/pizza/pizza.owl#Pizza"/>
                    <owl:Class>
                        <owl:complementOf>
                            <owl:Restriction>
                                <owl:onProperty rdf:resource="http://www.co-ode.org/ontologies/pizza/pizza.owl#hasTopping"/>
                                <owl:someValuesFrom rdf:resource="http://www.co-ode.org/ontologies/pizza/pizza.owl#FishTopping"/>
                            </owl:Restriction>
                        </owl:complementOf>
                    </owl:Class>
                    <owl:Class>
                        <owl:complementOf>
                            <owl:Restriction>
                                <owl:onProperty rdf:resource="http://www.co-ode.org/ontologies/pizza/pizza.owl#hasTopping"/>
                                <owl:someValuesFrom rdf:resource="http://www.co-ode.org/ontologies/pizza/pizza.owl#MeatTopping"/>

                        </owl:complementOf>
                    </owl:Class>
                </owl:intersectionOf>
            </owl:Class>
        </owl:equivalentClass>

    </owl:Class>

                        <owl:allValuesFrom rdf:resource="http://www.co-ode.org/ontologies/pizza/pizza.owl#VegetarianTopping"/>
                    </owl:Restriction>
                </owl:intersectionOf>
            </owl:Class>
        </owl:equivalentClass>
        <rdfs:comment xml:lang="en">Any pizza that only has vegetarian toppings or no toppings is a VegetarianPizzaEquiv1. Should be inferred to be equivalent to VegetarianPizzaEquiv2.  Not equivalent to VegetarianPizza because PizzaTopping is not covering</rdfs:comment>

        <rdfs:label xml:lang="en">VegetarianPizza1</rdfs:label>
        <skos:prefLabel xml:lang="en">Vegetarian Pizza1</skos:prefLabel>
    </owl:Class>

                <owl:intersectionOf rdf:parseType="Collection">

                                    <rdf:Description rdf:about="http://www.co-ode.org/ontologies/pizza/pizza.owl#VegetableTopping"/>
                                </owl:unionOf>
                            </owl:Class>
                        </owl:allValuesFrom>
                    </owl:Restriction>
                </owl:intersectionOf>
            </owl:Class>
        </owl:equivalentClass>

4. The SPARQL query in the question uses `?pizza rdfs:subClassOf pizza:SeafoodPizza`, which would only return subclasses of **SeafoodPizza**. The parent class is used in restrictions, and the covering axiom means that only members of the subclasses may be used as values.                             </owl:Restriction>
                        </owl:complementOf>
                    </owl:Class>

                        <owl:complementOf>

                                </owl:unionOf>
                            </owl:Class>
                        </owl:allValuesFrom>
                    </owl:Restriction>
                </owl:intersectionOf>
            </owl:Class>

responses.answer:
**Pizzas with more than three toppings**

- American  
- AmericanHot  
- Cajun  
- Capricciosa  
- Caprina  
- Fiorentina  
- FourSeasons  
- FruttiDiMare  
- Giardiniera  
- LaReine  
- Mushroom  
- Napoletana  
- Parmense  
- PolloAdAstra  
- PrinceCarlo  
- QuattroFormaggi  
- Rosa  
- Siciliana  
- SloppyGiuseppe  
- Soho  
- UnclosedPizza  
- Veneziana  

**Inference steps**

1. For each pizza class, the ontology specifies a restriction on `hasTopping` with a `someValuesFrom` (or `allValuesFrom`) union of specific topping classes.  
2. The union lists the exact topping classes allowed for that pizza.  
3. Counting the items in each union gives the number of distinct toppings a pizza can have.  
4. All pizzas listed above have 4 or more toppings in their union (e.g., Capricciosa has 13, FruttiDiMare has 5, etc.).  
5. The only pizza whose union contains fewer than four toppings is **Margherita** (only `MozzarellaTopping` and `TomatoTopping`).  
6. Therefore, every pizza except Margherita satisfies the “more than three toppings” condition.

The parent class is used in restrictions, and the covering axiom means that only members of the subclasses may be used as values. The possible subclasses cannot be extended without updating the ValuePartition class.</rdfs:comment>

                                <owl:onProperty rdf:resource="http://www.co-ode.org/ontologies/pizza/pizza.owl#hasTopping"/>

                            </owl:Restriction>
                        </owl:complementOf>
                    </owl:Class>
                    <owl:Class>
                        <owl:complementOf>
                            <owl:Restriction>
                                <owl:onProperty rdf:resource="http://www.co-ode.org/ontologies/pizza/pizza.owl#hasTopping"/>
                                <owl:someValuesFrom rdf:resource="http://www.co-ode.org/ontologies/pizza/pizza.owl#MeatTopping"/>
                            </owl:Restriction>

                    </owl:Class>
                </owl:intersectionOf>
            </owl:Class>

                                    <rdf:Description rdf:about="http://www.co-ode.org/ontologies/pizza/pizza.owl#SauceTopping"/>
                                    <rdf:Description rdf:about="http://www.co-ode.org/ontologies/pizza/pizza.owl#VegetableTopping"/>
                                </owl:unionOf>
                            </owl:Class>
                        </owl:allValuesFrom>
                    </owl:Restriction>
                </owl:intersectionOf>
            </owl:Class>
        </owl:equivalentClass>

                    <rdf:Description rdf:about="http://www.co-ode.org/ontologies/pizza/pizza.owl#PizzaTopping"/>
                    <owl:Class>
                        <owl:unionOf rdf:parseType="Collection">
                            <rdf:Description rdf:about="http://www.co-ode.org/ontologies/pizza/pizza.owl#CheeseTopping"/>
                            <rdf:Description rdf:about="http://www.co-ode.org/ontologies/pizza/pizza.owl#FruitTopping"/>

            </owl:Class>
        </owl:equivalentClass>
